gloss: introduction; preface (of a thesis or essay)

definitions.explanation: The opening section of a thesis, essay, or academic work that presents the topic, purpose, and scope. Used primarily in academic and formal writing contexts.

examples.japanese: {序論|じょろん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{書|か}く→書く：00477_kaku⟧。
⟦{論文|ろんぶん}→論文：03787_ronbun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{序論|じょろん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{研究|けんきゅう}→研究：01396_kenkyuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{目的|もくてき}→目的：02433_mokuteki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{述|の}べた→述べる：02389_noberu⟧。
examples.english: I stated the purpose of the research in the introduction of the thesis.

examples.japanese: {序論|じょろん}・⟦{本論|ほんろん}→本論：29499_honron⟧・⟦{結論|けつろん}→結論：02704_ketsuron⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{三|さん}→三：00749_san⟧つ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{分|わ}けて→分ける：02333_wakeru⟧⟦{書|か}き→書く：00477_kaku⟧⟦なさい→なさる：01307_nasaru⟧。
examples.english: Write it divided into three parts: introduction, main body, and conclusion.
Even just the introduction of this book is worth reading.

notes:
Composed of {序|じょ} (preface, order) and ⟦{論|ろん}→〜論：04017_ron⟧ (argument, essay). Refers specifically to the introductory section of an academic paper or formal essay, where the writer sets out the background, purpose, and scope of the work.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {序論|じょろん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{書|か}く→書く：00477_kaku⟧: to write an introduction
- ⟦{論文|ろんぶん}→論文：03787_ronbun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{序論|じょろん}: thesis introduction
- {序論|じょろん}・⟦{本論|ほんろん}→本論：29499_honron⟧・⟦{結論|けつろん}→結論：02704_ketsuron⟧: introduction, body, conclusion

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{序文|じょぶん}→序文：06205_jobun⟧: preface, foreword — written by the author before the main text; less academic than {序論|じょろん}
- ⟦{前書|まえが}き→前書き：17127_maegaki⟧: foreword, preface — a more casual opening note
- ⟦{導入|どうにゅう}→導入：10127_dounyuu⟧: introduction — broader term; can also mean introducing a system or concept, not just a written section
- ⟦イントロ→イントロ：30028_intoro⟧: intro — casual loanword abbreviation, often used for music
